items.title: 12.2.3 Ammonium salts se ammonia ki tayyari (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.2.3 with Figure 12.3 and Quick Check 12.1, printed page 275.

blocks.text: Laboratory mein ammonia gas kisi ammonium salt, jaise ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl), ko kisi base, jaise calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂), ke saath garam kar ke banai ja sakti hai (Figure 12.3).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne equation NH₄Cl + Ca(OH)₂ → NaCl + H₂O + NH₃ chhapi hai. Reactants mein sodium hai hi nahi, is liye NaCl nahi ban sakta; calcium chloride (CaCl₂) banta hai. Kitab ki equation balanced bhi nahi. Sahi: 2NH₄Cl + Ca(OH)₂ → CaCl₂ + 2H₂O + 2NH₃.

Is acid-base reaction mein NH₄⁺ H⁺ de kar acid ka kaam karta hai, aur OH⁻ H⁺ le kar base ka kaam karta hai. Yeh reaction ammonium salt se ammonia gas ko bahar nikal (displace kar) deta hai aur salt aur pani banata hai. Salt analysis mein ammonium pehchanne ke liye yahi test kiya jata hai: agar teez (pungent) boo wali gas nikle jo geele surkh (red) litmus paper ko neela (blue) kar de, to compound mein ammonium maujood hai.

blocks.alt: Laboratory ka set-up. Safed thos mixture wali boiling tube stand par clamp ki gai hai aur us ke band sire ko burner garam kar raha hai; us ka munh thora neeche jhuka hai aur cork se band hai. Delivery tube drying tower ke paon tak jati hai jo safed dalon (lumps) se bhara hai. Tower ke oopar se ek nali ulte rakhe gas jar mein jati hai jo doosre stand se thama hai; jar ke munh par teer hawa ko bahar nikalta dikhate hain. Ishara-teer mixture, dalon aur jar ki taraf hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.3: Ammonia gas ki tayyari (kitab ki Figure 12.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen ishara-teer (kitab mein in par naam nahi): pehla tube mein NH4Cl aur Ca(OH)2 ke mixture ki taraf, doosra drying tower ke dalon ki taraf (yeh gas ko khushk karte hain), teesra ulte gas jar ki taraf jahan ammonia jama hoti hai; ammonia hawa se halki hai is liye jar ulta rakha jata hai aur hawa neeche se nikal jati hai. Kitab ki shakal mein tube ka band (garam) sira neeche aur munh oopar ki taraf utha hua hai; is tarah bana pani wapas garam sheeshe par beh kar tube tor sakta hai. Hamare khaake mein munh thora neeche jhuka hai, jo sahi tareeqa hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Khane ki packing (food packaging) mein N₂ gas kyun istemal hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: N₂ inert hai, yani khane se react nahi karti. Packet mein hawa (oxygen aur nami) ki jagah N₂ bhar di jati hai, to khana oxidise ho kar kharab nahi hota, bacteria aur fungus nahi barhte, aur gas ka 'takiya' chips jaisi cheezon ko tootne se bachata hai.

blocks.prompt: b) CO aur N₂ dono mein triple bond hai. CO, N₂ se zyada reactive kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: N₂ mein dono atoms ek jaise hain, is liye bond bilkul non-polar hai. CO mein C aur O mukhtalif atoms hain, electronegativity ka farq hai, is liye molecule polar hai; carbon par ek lone pair hai jo aasani se doosre atom (masalan metal) ko diya ja sakta hai. Is polarity aur lone pair ki wajah se CO zyada reactive hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Ammonium salts jaise (NH₄)₂SO₄ ya NH₄NO₃ fertilizer hain. Kisan ammonium fertilizer aur chuna (lime) ek saath khet mein kyun nahi dalta? Kaun se reactions hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Chuna (CaO ya Ca(OH)₂) base hai. Base ammonium salt se ammonia gas nikal deta hai jo hawa mein ur jati hai, aur fertilizer ki nitrogen zaya ho jati hai: (NH₄)₂SO₄ + Ca(OH)₂ → CaSO₄ + 2H₂O + 2NH₃ aur 2NH₄NO₃ + Ca(OH)₂ → Ca(NO₃)₂ + 2H₂O + 2NH₃.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke sawal (c) mein ammonium nitrate ka formula (NH₄)₂NO₃ likha hai. Sahi formula NH₄NO₃ hai, kyun ke ek NH₄⁺ ion ek NO₃⁻ ion ke charge ko barabar karta hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Jalta hua magnesium ribbon N₂O wale jar mein rakhein to woh roshan jalta rehta hai. Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Jalte magnesium ki garmi N₂O ko tor deti hai aur oxygen azad ho jati hai, jis mein magnesium jalta rehta hai: Mg + N₂O → MgO + N₂. Isi liye Table 12.2 mein likha hai ke N₂O jalne (combustion) mein madad karti hai.

items: Ammonium salt + base garam karein → NH₃ gas: 2NH₄Cl + Ca(OH)₂ → CaCl₂ + 2H₂O + 2NH₃.
NH₄⁺ acid (H⁺ deta hai), OH⁻ base (H⁺ leta hai).
Pehchan: teez boo wali gas jo geele surkh litmus ko neela kare = ammonium.
